scenario: New Lead Captured → GHL Pipeline + Follow-up Sequence
trigger: POST from /api/webhooks/meta or GHL webhook (external trigger)
description: Fires when a new lead is captured from Meta ads, organic DMs, or manual entry. Make.com creates or updates the GHL contact, adds the lead to the correct pipeline stage, enrolls them in the appropriate follow-up sequence, and notifies the assigned setter via Discord.

payload.name: string — lead's full name
payload.email: string | null — lead's email if captured
payload.assignedSetter: string | null — setter name if already assigned

makeSteps: Step 1: Receive webhook — parse lead info
Step 2: Search GHL for existing contact by email/phone — create if not found
Step 3: Move GHL contact to 'New Lead' pipeline stage
Step 4: Enroll in follow-up SMS/email sequence based on source
Step 5: Send Discord notification to setter-alerts channel with lead details
Step 6: (Optional) Assign lead to setter round-robin if no setter specified
